title: Destinies Converge
next_chapter_hook: The Tianji Record delivered a prophecy: 'Chapter Seven Hundred, death approaches, the path to breaking the situation lies in...' The prophecy broke off here, and Chen Ji felt a sharp sting in his fingertips.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered like a candle in the wind, the warning still echoing in his ears, yet Chen Ji had already stepped out of the ancient ruins' barrier. The spiritual mist dispersed, the familiar mountain path stretched before him, and Tianqing Sect lay ahead. 'The Eye of Heaven never sleeps'—he pressed these words into the deepest corner of his heart, his fingers unconsciously brushing the slightly scalding Tianji Record Fragment in his arms. The exhilaration of breaking through multiple realms in the ruins still lingered, the aura of Golden Core peak circulated through his meridians, every inch of bone filled with unprecedented power. He gazed at the distant sect main hall, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes. After playing the pig to devour the tiger for so long, it was time for a change of taste.

The mountain wind shifted abruptly, a biting killing intent like a venomous snake locked onto Chen Ji's back. His footsteps halted, yet a playful arc curled at the corner of his mouth—he had been waiting for you. 'Chen Ji, boy, you think acquiring the ruins' fortune means you can leave safely?' An aged and sinister voice came from all directions, and among the swaying shadows of trees, a withered figure gradually emerged. The old man had white hair and beard, dressed in a dark cyan Taoist robe—he was precisely Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master Ling Yuan. His gaze was like a vulture examining prey, full of greed and cruelty: 'Hand over the Tianji Record, and I'll spare your corpse intact.'

dialogue.content: This old man has waited sixty years for this day.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly turned, meeting Ling Yuan's gaze. He didn't retreat half a step, didn't show the panic atrash should have. Instead, he tilted his head slightly, revealing a rather gentle smile: 'Sect Master Ling, are you certain you want to动手 here?' Before the words even finished, his aura erupted—Golden Core peak spiritual pressure poured out like a mountain collapse and tsunami! Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply, that dominance far exceeding his expectations. How is this possible? Thistrash was clearly still at Foundation Building when he left the ruins! In these mere three days, what exactly did he experience?

Ling Yuan's expression turned gloomy as water. He waved his sleeve, and three sword lights pierced through the air, heading straight for Chen Ji's vital points. 'This old man wants to see if your so-called breakthrough is real or false!' The sword lights carried the pressure of Core Formation realm, and ordinary Golden Core cultivators would be hard-pressed to withstand them. Yet Chen Ji moved. His form flickered like a ghost—the first sword light was caught between his two fingers, the second was blocked by his shoulder, and the third was blown away by a single breath. Golden Core peak versus Core Formation—a complete碾压, absolute碾压. Ling Yuan's reliance was nothing but a joke before him.

Ling Yuan stumbled backward, a trace of blood bleeding from the corner of his mouth, his eyes full of disbelief: 'How could you—' Before he could finish, a long and powerful palm had already seized his throat. Chen Ji lifted this respectable former Sect Master with one hand, his gaze cold as looking at an ant: 'Sixty years ago, why did the Tianji Record skip over you and choose my grandfather?' Ling Yuan's eyeballs bulged, gurgling sounds came from his throat, yet he suddenly laughed, his smile carrying an indescribable mockery: 'You think... the退婚... was merely the Su family's intention? Hahaha... too naive...'

dialogue.content: That was the tacit understanding between the three major sects... and the Holy Sect. Your Chen family blocked too many people's paths.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers tightened slightly, a sharp light flickering in his eyes. Three major sects, Holy Sect... this chess game was even larger than he imagined. Ling Yuan felt the killing intent growing stronger, yet he forced a twisted smile: 'You think killing this old man ends it? Tianqing Sect... is merely a piece... the real chess player...' The voice cut off abruptly; Chen Ji didn't give him a chance to finish. With a surge of spiritual power, Ling Yuan's body shattered like broken porcelain, dissolving into scattered spiritual light that vanished between heaven and earth. A generation's former Sect Master, fallen thus. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, letting the mountain wind stir his robes, yet his heart was as calm as an ancient well—recorded, waiting for the right moment.

After dealing with Ling Yuan, Chen Ji收敛 his aura, suppressing his realm back to mid-Foundation Building before leisurely entering the sect. His return was like a stone dropped into a calm lake, and soon news spread throughout Tianqing Sect. Elder Wu personally came to greet, announcing in the sect main hall: 'Chen Ji performed exceptionally in the ancient ruins, retrieved the sect's lost treasure, his meritorious service outstanding. Special promotion to Inner Sect core disciple, rewarded with a thousand medium-grade spirit stones, a Mystery-grade technique 'Tianxuan Art', and three months of cultivation access to the sect's Forbidden Grounds!' At these words, the entire hall erupted, countless envious and disbelieving gazes fell upon that seemingly ordinary youth.

dialogue.content: 'Atrash can achieve such a great contribution? Elder Wu, you must open your eyes wide and see clearly!'

text.content: The number one genius of Xuanwu Sect, Han Lie, strode into the hall, his entire being radiating killing intent. His physique was sturdy, his momentum profound—he was universally acknowledged as the top cultivator of his generation among the three major sects. At this moment, he stared at Chen Ji with an almost condescending attitude, as if looking at an ant: 'You must have stumbled upon some treasure in the ruins to侥幸 pass. Atrash is always atrash, let's see how long you can be arrogant!' The surrounding disciples whispered among themselves, their gazes toward Chen Ji growing increasingly complex. Yet Chen Ji merely glanced at Han Lie indifferently, that gazecalm得可怕—not fear, but pity.

The hall's atmosphere was tense as a drawn bow. Just as Elder Wu was about to mediate, Chen Ji stepped forward first. His pace was unhurried, each step landing precisely on Han Lie's heartstring. 'Young Master Han,' his voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears, 'Do you know how many elite disciples Xuanwu Sect lost in the ruins?' Han Lie's expression changed—he had indeed received news—Xuanwu Sect's expedition had nearly been wiped out, with only a handful of people returning in a sorry state. He stared at Chen Ji, trying to find a flaw in that composed face, yet only saw an abyss-like darkness.

choice.prompt: Han Lie challenged publicly with many disciples watching. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.visible_reward: Shock the entire audience, establish his reputation among the three major sects

text.content: A subtle arc lifted at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, and his aura surged forth like a tide—not mid-Foundation Building, but genuine Golden Core peak! 'Young Master Han said atrash is always atrash, didn't you?' He raised his hand and flicked a single finger. A terrifying spiritual pressure instantly forced Han Lie's knees to bend, blood trickling from the corner of his mouth. The堂堂 Xuanwu Sect number one genius, crushed by a single finger before the watching crowd! 'Now, who is thetrash?'

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his aura and smiled faintly: 'Young Master Han is quick to judge others, I wonder what your sister would think if she learned you lingered outside the ruins for three days without daring to venture deeper?' At these words, Han Lie's face changed dramatically. The surrounding disciples drew a sharp breath—turns out the so-called number one genius was merely a turtle head in the ruins? Han Lie trembled with rage, yet could find no words, having to turn and leave with resentment.

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, assuming a timid expression: 'Young Master Han's教训 is right, little brother admits his mistake.' This servile posture made everyone present secretly shake their heads—indeed a扶不上墙的trash. Yet no one noticed the faint smile at the corner of his lowered face. Playing the pig to devour the tiger was precisely his best act. Han Lie coldly snorted and swept his sleeves to leave, yet an inexplicable sense of unease sprouted in his heart.

The commotion faded, and the sect main hall returned to tranquility. Elder Wu cast a meaningful glance at Chen Ji before finally waving his hand to dismiss him. Walking back to his cave dwelling, Chen Ji's state of mind was far less calm than his surface suggested. Ling Yuan's dying words were like a thorn lodged in his heart—three major sects, Holy Sect, a multi-party chess game, and he, Chen Ji, had been the targeted piece from the very beginning. The Tianji Record Fragment in his arms grew slightly hot, as if sensing its master's mood fluctuations. Chen Ji stopped, closed his eyes, and dove his consciousness into that mysterious gray-white space.

In the gray-white space, the Tianji Record Fragment hovered quietly, emanating a faint glow. New prophecy was slowly emerging—golden characters writhing like serpents, stroke by stroke branding themselves into Chen Ji's consciousness: 'Chapter Seven Hundred, death approaches, the path to breaking the situation lies in...' The characters abruptly stopped, as if cut off by some force. The fragment trembled violently, the burning sensation spreading through his meridians to his entire body. Chen Ji groaned, cold sweat beading on his forehead. This was the second time the Tianji Record showed an incomplete prophecy—the first was about Chen Nian's whereabouts, and this time... Chapter Seven Hundred, that meant still 310 chapters away.

Chen Ji exited the consciousness space, and when he opened his eyes, night had deepened. Outside the cave dwelling, moonlight如水, he stood with hands behind his back, gazing at the distant layered mountains. The Tianji Record's warning, Ling Yuan's dying words, the conspiracy behind the退婚, his sister's whereabouts... one after another intertwined, forming a vast and complex web. And he stood at the center of the web, or perhaps the one holding the net? Chen Ji gently exhaled a breath of turbid air, an icy flame kindling in the depths of his eyes. Since Heaven wants to use him as a piece, he would be the hand that overturns the chessboard. Chapter Seven Hundred, death approaches? Very well, let's see whose death sentence it truly is. As destinies converge, a new chapter begins.
